43864-running-fox.title: Running Fox
43864-running-fox.creator: Unknown
43864-running-fox.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “My son, you have asked me to tell you the greatest thing a Delaware can do. Far away toward Lowaneu, The-Place-Where-The-Cold-Comes-From, in the Mohawk camp, lives a great war-leader named Standing Wolf. You have heard our warriors talk about him at the council-fires. He has killed many of our people. We have fought many battles with him, but we cannot kill him.

72742-a-christmas-prayer.title: [Illustration: Decoration]
72742-a-christmas-prayer.creator: James W. Foley
72742-a-christmas-prayer.description: A book by James W. Foley. So now when hearts grow kind and Yule-logs burn,   When thoughts grow gentler, sweeter, and return   To olden, golden friends, or far or near,   This prayer of mine be hallowed with a tear   Welled from the fount of love and sympathy,   And sent upon the wintry night to Thee,   Till all the world is warmed with love divine,----   Dear Lord, bless all these olden friends of mine!

arxiv-1902-10165.title: Diameter of P.A. random graphs with edge-step functions
arxiv-1902-10165.creator: Caio Alves 1, Rodrigo Ribeiro 2, Rémy Sanchis 3
arxiv-1902-10165.description: Abstract . In this work we prove general bounds for the diameter of random graphs generated by a preferential attachment model whose parameter is a function f : ℕ → [ 0 , 1 ] f:\mathbb{N}\to[0,1] that drives the asymptotic proportion between the numbers of vertices and edges.

arxiv-2004-11483.title: Spatiotemporal data analysis with chronological networks
arxiv-2004-11483.creator: Leonardo N. Ferreira, Didier A. Vega-Oliveros, Moshé Cotacallapa, Manoel F. Cardoso, Marcos G. Quiles, Liang Zhao, Elbert E. N. Macau
arxiv-2004-11483.description: Abstract The number of spatiotemporal data sets has increased rapidly in the last years, which demands robust and fast methods to extract information from this kind of data. Here, we propose a network-based model, called Chronnet, for spatiotemporal data analysis. The network construction process consists of dividing a geometric space into grid cells represented by nodes connected chronologically.

arxiv-2112-14314.title: Improving Prediction of Cognitive Performance using Deep Neural Networks in Sparse Data
arxiv-2112-14314.creator: Sharath Koorathota, Arunesh Mittal, Richard Sloan, Paul Sajda
arxiv-2112-14314.description: Abstract Cognition in midlife is an important predictor of age-related mental decline and statistical models that predict cognitive performance can be useful for predicting decline. However, existing models struggle to capture complex relationships between physical, sociodemographic, psychological and mental health factors that effect cognition.

arxiv-2305-13551.title: How Fragile is Relation Extraction under Entity Replacements?
arxiv-2305-13551.creator: Yiwei Wang Bryan Hooi Fei Wang Yujun Cai Yuxuan Liang, Wenxuan Zhou Jing Tang Manjuan Duan Muhao Chen
arxiv-2305-13551.description: Abstract Relation extraction (RE) aims to extract the relations between entity names from the textual context . In principle, textual context determines the ground-truth relation and the RE models should be able to correctly identify the relations reflected by the textual context.

arxiv-2307-07794.title: Available observation time regulates optimal balance between sensitivity and confidence
arxiv-2307-07794.creator: Sahel Azizpour 1,2, Viola Priesemann 3,4, Johannes Zierenberg 3,∗, Anna Levina 1,2,∗
arxiv-2307-07794.description: Abstract Tasks that require information about the world imply a trade-off between the time spent on observation and the variance of the response. In particular, fast decisions need to rely on uncertain information. However, standard estimates of information processing capabilities, such as the dynamic range, are defined based on mean values that assume infinite observation times.

arxiv-2310-09316.title: Exploring Chaos and Ergodic behavior of an Inductorless Circuit driven by Stochastic Parameters Thanks: S. Seth and A. Bera have contributed equally.
arxiv-2310-09316.creator: Soumyajit Seth, Abhijit Bera, Vikram Pakrashi
arxiv-2310-09316.description: Abstract There exist extensive studies on periodic and random perturbations of various continuous maps investigating their dynamics. This paper presents a random piecewise smooth map derived from a simple inductor-less switching circuit. The bifurcation parameter is bounded and randomly selected from a stationary distribution.

arxiv-2404-00373.title: The Devil is in the Edges: Monocular Depth Estimation with Edge-aware Consistency Fusion
arxiv-2404-00373.creator: Pengzhi Li, Yikang Ding, Haohan Wang, Chengshuai Tang, Zhiheng Li
arxiv-2404-00373.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pengzhi Li, Yikang Ding, Haohan Wang, Chengshuai Tang, Zhiheng Li. This paper presents a novel monocular depth estimation method, named ECFNet, for estimating high-quality monocular depth with clear edges and valid overall structure from a single RGB image. We make a thorough inquiry about the key factor that affects the edge depth estimation of the MDE networks, and come to a ratiocination that the edge information itself plays a critical role in predicting depth details.

arxiv-2410-11585.title: Index estimate by first Betti number of minimal hypersurfaces in compact symmetric spaces
arxiv-2410-11585.creator: Toru Kajigaya and Keita Kunikawa
arxiv-2410-11585.description: Abstract . We show that the Morse index of unstable closed minimal hypersurface Σ \Sigma in a compact semi-simple Riemannian symmetric space M = G / K M=G/K is bounded from below by constant times the first Betti number of Σ \Sigma .

arxiv-2411-02306.title: On Targeted Manipulation and Deception when Optimizing LLMs for User Feedback
arxiv-2411-02306.creator: Marcus Williams & Micah Carroll *, Adhyyan Narang, Constantin Weisser, Brendan Murphy, Anca Dragan
arxiv-2411-02306.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Marcus Williams & Micah Carroll *, Adhyyan Narang, Constantin Weisser, Brendan Murphy, Anca Dragan. As LLMs become more widely deployed, there is increasing interest in directly optimizing for feedback from end users (e.g. thumbs up) in addition to feedback from paid annotators. However, training to maximize human feedback creates a perverse incentive structure for the AI to resort to manipulative or deceptive tactics to obtain positive feedback from users who are vulnerable to such strategies.

arxiv-2411-05592.title: Turbulent Boundary Layer in a 3-Element High-Lift Wing: Coherent Structures Identification
arxiv-2411-05592.creator: R. Montalà, B. Eiximeno, A. Miró, O. Lehmkuhl, I. Rodríguez
arxiv-2411-05592.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The reduction of fuel consumption in airplanes has always stand as a very appealing topic for the aeronautical industry. Economical savings and a lower environmental impact are the main benefits that companies aim to reach with it.

arxiv-2411-07020.title: Premerger observation and characterization of massive black hole binaries
arxiv-2411-07020.creator: Gareth Cabourn Davies, Ian Harry, Michael J. Williams, Diganta Bandopadhyay, Leor Barack, Jean-Baptiste Bayle, Charlie Hoy, Antoine Klein, Hannah Middleton, Christopher J. Moore, Laura Nuttall, Geraint Pratten, Alberto Vecchio, Graham Woan
arxiv-2411-07020.description: Abstract We demonstrate an end-to-end technique for observing and characterizing massive black hole binary signals before they merge with the LISA space-based gravitational-wave observatory. Our method uses a zero-latency whitening filter, originally designed for rapidly observing compact binary mergers in ground-based observatories, to be able to observe signals with no additional latency due to filter length.

arxiv-2502-01830.title: Meta-neural Topology Optimization: Knowledge Infusion with Meta-learning
arxiv-2502-01830.creator: Igor Kuszczak, Gaweł Kuś, Federico Bosi, Miguel A. Bessa
arxiv-2502-01830.description: Abstract When faced with novel design problems, traditional topology optimization methods discard all prior design experience and start from a uniform initial guess. While this avoids biasing the optimizer towards any particular solution, it also means that many computationally expensive iterations are needed to converge.

arxiv-2502-03968.title: Using Lagrangian descriptors to reveal the phase space structure of dynamical systems described by fractional differential equations: Application to the Duffing oscillator
arxiv-2502-03968.creator: Dylan Theron, Hadi Susanto, Makrina Agaoglou, Charalampos Skokos
arxiv-2502-03968.description: Abstract We showcase the utility of the Lagrangian descriptors method in qualitatively understanding the underlying dynamical behavior of dynamical systems governed by fractional-order differential equations. In particular, we use the Lagrangian descriptors method to study the phase space structure of the unforced and undamped Duffing oscillator when its time evolution is governed by fractional-order differential equations.

arxiv-2602-21299.title: Ab Initio Random Matrix Theory of Molecular Electronic Structure
arxiv-2602-21299.creator: Zhen Tao, Victor Galitski
arxiv-2602-21299.description: Abstract We use ab initio electronic-structure methods to investigate random-matrix theory (RMT) universality in molecular electronic structure. Using single-reference electronic structure methods, including Hartree-Fock, configuration-interaction singles (CIS), density functional theory, and linear-response time-dependent density-functional theory (LR-TDDFT), we compute single-particle orbital energies and many-electron excitations of several representative molecules (benzene, alanine, 1‑phenylethylamine, methyloxirane, and helicene chains).

plos-pone-0357088.creator: Xiaoming Li, Chuanxu Li, Liqiang Xi, Yudong Zhu, Panpan Dong, Peitong Chen, Fan Zhang, Fayong Yang
plos-pone-0357088.description: Insights into thermo-oxidative aging properties and mechanisms of high-content desulfurized rubber modified asphalt: A macro-rheological and micro-chemical perspective

pmc-10507708.title: Newborn hearing screening program in China: a narrative review of the issues in screening and management
pmc-10507708.creator: Cheng Wen, Li-Hui Huang
pmc-10507708.description: Hearing loss is one of the most common sensory disorders in humans. The purpose of this review is to summarize the history and current status of newborn hearing screening in China and to investigate future developmental trends in newborn hearing screening with the intention of sharing experiences and providing a reference for other populations.

pmc-10551570.title: Isosterism in pyrrole via azaboroles substitution, a theoretical investigation for electronic structural, stability and aromaticity
pmc-10551570.creator: Safinaz H. El-Demerdash, Shaimaa F. Gad, Ibrahim M. El-Mehasseb, Khaled E. El-Kelany
pmc-10551570.description: This work uses ab-initio CBS-QB3 and density functional theory (B3LYP) to analyze the structure, stability, and aromaticity of all isosteric nitrogen-boron pyrroles. The mono-NB unit substituted group of the isosteric NB pyrrole has four isosteres, whereas the multi-NB unit substituted group has two isosteres. These two groups make up all isosteric NB pyrrole.

pmc-10576582.title: Successful intra-abdominal resection of a 24 kg ovarian granulosa cell tumor in a Warmblood mare
pmc-10576582.creator: Simone Della Tommasa, Susanne Pauline Roth, Theresa Triebe, Walter Brehm, Katharina Luise Lohmann, Sabita Diana Stöckle
pmc-10576582.description: Background:Granulosa cell tumors (GCTs) are the most common ovarian tumors in mares. The classical presentation of a GCT is a unilaterally enlarged ovary appearing as a multicystic honeycomb mass. In rare cases, GCTs cause hemoperitoneum as a result of the rapid growth of the tumor.

pmc-10914638.title: Usp25-Erlin1/2 activity limits cholesterol flux to restrict virus infection
pmc-10914638.creator: Qi Wen Teo, Ho Him Wong, Tiaan Heunis, Viktoriya Stancheva, Asmaa Hachim, Huibin Lv, Lewis Siu, Julian Ho, Yun Lan, Chris Ka Pun Mok, Rachel Ulferts, Sumana Sanyal
pmc-10914638.description: SummaryReprogramming lipid metabolic pathways is a critical feature of activating immune responses to infection. However, how these reconfigurations occur is poorly understood. Our previous screen to identify cellular deubiquitylases (DUBs) activated during influenza virus infection revealed Usp25 as a prominent hit.

pmc-11350260.title: Revolutionizing wild silk fibers: Ultrasound enhances structure, properties, and regenerability of protein biomaterials in ionic liquids
pmc-11350260.creator: Xincheng Zhuang, Haomiao Zhu, Fang Wang, Xiao Hu
pmc-11350260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Graphical abstract Introduction In the past decades, the extensive use of non-biodegradable and petroleum-based materials has caused significant negative impacts on the environment [1], [2]. Considering the rising oil prices in recent years and national efforts to develop renewable resources, it is likely that fossil resources such as coal, oil, and their derivatives will become scarce, exacerbating the impacts of the energy crisis [3].

pmc-11416551.title: Prognostic nomogram for the patency of wrist autologous arteriovenous fistula in first year
pmc-11416551.creator: Yu Li, Jinming Yang, Yue Chen, Wenhao Cui, Jukun Wang, Chao Zhang, Linzhong Zhu, Chunjing Bian, Tao Luo
pmc-11416551.description: SummaryAutologous arteriovenous fistula (AVF) is preferred in hemodialysis patients. Maintaining its patency is a critical problem. This study aimed to create a nomogram model for predicting 1-year primary patency of AVF. Consequently, a total of 414 patients were retrospectively enrolled and randomly allocated to training and validation cohorts.

pmc-11513472.title: Multiproxy quantitative paleoceanographic dataset from late Quaternary marine sediment archives in the western Ross Sea (Antarctica)
pmc-11513472.creator: Fiorenza Torricella, Ester Colizza, Gianluca Cornamusini, Paola Del Carlo, Federico Giglio, Jong Kuk Hong, Boo-Keun Khim, Gerhard Kuhn, Patrizia Macrì, Elisa Malinverno, Romana Melis, Leonardo Sagnotti, Bianca Scateni, Mirko Severi, Rita Traversi, Kyu-Cheul Yoo, Luca Zurli, Lucilla Capotondi
pmc-11513472.description: The past ice sheet dynamics and the timing of retreat events in the paleo-record in the Ross Sea is an issue still few understood. In order to contribute to this topic, we provide a multiproxy data from marine sediment archives (cores and box cores) collected in three sites in the Central Basin (Western Ross Sea, Antarctica).

pmc-11555526.title: Development of 2-Aminoadenine-Based Proteolysis-Targeting Chimeras (PROTACs) as Novel Potent Degraders of Monopolar Spindle 1 and Aurora Kinases
pmc-11555526.creator: Eleni Sflakidou, Bikash Adhikari, Christos Siokatas, Elmar Wolf, Vasiliki Sarli
pmc-11555526.description: Monopolar spindle 1 (Mps1, also known as TTK) and Aurora kinase (AURK) A and B are critical regulators of mitosis and have been linked to the progression of various cancers. Here, we report the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of a series of PROTACs (proteolysis-targeting chimeras) targeting TTK and AURKs.

pmc-11597847.title: GC–MS Characterization and Bioactivity Study of Eucalyptus globulus Labill. (Myrtaceae) Essential Oils and Their Fractions: Antibacterial and Antioxidant Properties and Molecular Docking Modeling
pmc-11597847.creator: Abdessamad Ait benlabchir, Kawtar Fikri-Benbrahim, Amina Moutawalli, Mohammed M Alanazi, Asma Halmoune, Fatima Zahra Benkhouili, Asmaa Oubihi, Atul Kabra, Elbatoul Hanoune, Hamza Assila, Zineb Benziane Ouaritini, Andrea Maxia, Emma Cocco
pmc-11597847.description: Background/Objectives: Eucalyptus globulus is a medicinal plant extensively used by the Moroccan population for treating a range of illnesses, especially respiratory conditions. Methods: This study aimed to assess the antioxidant and antibacterial properties of E. globulus essential oil and its individual fractions (F1, F2, and F3).

pmc-12645064.title: Mutations in retinal cyclic nucleotide-gated channels identified in familial cases of inherited retinal dystrophies from Pakistan
pmc-12645064.creator: Zainab Akhtar, Kiran Afshan, Yumei Li, Sumaira Altaf, Aleesha Asghar, Ume Sughra, Wajid Ali Khan, Haiba Kaul, Rui Chen, Sabika Firasat
pmc-12645064.description: PurposeCyclic nucleotide-gated (CNG) channels are ligand-gated ion channels that transduce light signals into electrical signals in the retinal photoreceptors. Pathogenic variants in CNG channel genes are reported to cause inherited retinal dystrophies (IRDs). The current study used targeted panel sequencing to describe the mutational spectrum of CNG channel genes in familial cases of IRDs from eight consanguineous Pakistani families.

pmc-13297084.title: Gonadogenesis in the Bearded Dragon (Pogona vitticeps, Agamidae): A Comprehensive Histological Analysis from Gonadal Ridge Formation to Testicular and Ovarian Development
pmc-13297084.creator: Izabela Rams-Pociecha, Paulina C. Mizia, Rafal P. Piprek

pmc-13392567.title: Surface bioengineering of lanthanide nanoparticles for theranostic applications: From hydrophilic modification to multimodal imaging and therapy
pmc-13392567.creator: Xuan Tan, Yunqiu Zhang, Shuping Wu, Dengyu Ma, Jinyu Yan, Jinwei Lu, Shikai Lin, Shiyan Li, Zhexin Hong, Shihui Jiang, Guowei Li
pmc-13392567.description: Lanthanide nanoparticles (LnNPs) are recognized as next-generation luminescent bioprobes due to their tunable emission spectra, long luminescence lifetimes, and high photostability. Although extensively studied, these nanomaterials have recently garnered renewed interest across biodetection, bioimaging, and therapeutics. To serve as suitable optical labels, LnNPs need to overcome inherent limitations such as hydrophobic surfaces, insufficient luminescence intensity, and limited environmental responsiveness.

pmc-13452207.title: Effect of photoperiod duration during incubation on hatch traits, growth, and behavior of Leghorn chicks to 21 days of age☆
pmc-13452207.creator: Celma E Ferreira dos Santos, Tory Shynkaruk, Eugenia Herwig, Bruce Rathgeber, Trever G Crowe, Henry L Classen, Karen Schwean-Lardner
pmc-13452207.description: This study determined the effects of photoperiod duration during incubation on Lohmann LSL-Lite hatch traits, growth, and behavior. Eggs (n = 1,200) were randomly assigned to one of four treatments: 0L:24D (0L), 6L:18D (6L), 12L:12D (12L), or 18L:6D (18L). Light was provided via red (641 nm) LED lamps.

pmc-13465506.title: Triple-vessel coronary involvement and giant aneurysm in a 6-year-old boy with kawasaki disease: a case report
pmc-13465506.creator: Mohammad-Taghi Majnoon, Mohammad Mehdi Rajabi, Sahar Hemati, Vahid Ziaee, Mohammad Rafati Navaei, Behdad Gharib
pmc-13465506.description: BackgroundKawasaki disease (KD) is an acute systemic vasculitis of unknown origin. It represents one of the most important causes of acquired heart disease in the pediatric population. Coronary artery involvement is the most serious complication and may result in aneurysm formation and thrombosis.

pmc-13471965.title: At‐Home Versus in‐Clinic Vital Capacity Measurement: Insights From the HEALEY ALS Platform Trial
